RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Lease is made at Bengaluru, Karnataka between Mr. Ramesh Gowda, residing at 14, 3rd Cross, Indiranagar, Bengaluru 560038 (the Owner) and Ms. Ananya Rao, residing at 27, 5th Main, Domlur, Bengaluru 560071, Aadhaar 4821 7734 9012, PAN ABCDE1234F, phone +91 98450 12345, email ananya.rao@example.com, UPI ananya@okhdfcbank (the Tenant).

1. Term of Lease. The lease shall be for a period of eleven (11) months commencing on the date of execution.

2. Notice Period. The Tenant shall provide three months written notice prior to vacating the premises.

3. Security Deposit. The Tenant shall pay an interest-free security deposit of Rs. 2,00,000 (Rupees Two Lakh only), equal to ten months rent.

4. Refund of Deposit. The security deposit shall be refunded after deduction of dues and damages, if any.
5. Lock-in Period. If the Tenant vacates before completion of eleven months, the Tenant shall forfeit four months rent as lock-in charges.
6. Maintenance and Exit Charges. The Tenant shall pay a painting charge of Rs. 40,000 at the time of vacating the premises.
